title: U.S. Stock Markets Decline Amid AI Concerns and Tariff Announcements
text:
• U.S. stock indexes fell sharply on February 27, 2025.
• The S&P 500 dropped 1.6%, marking its fifth decline in six days.
• The S&P 500 has lost 1.4% of its rally since Election Day.
• The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.47%.
• The Nasdaq composite tumbled 2.8%.
• Nvidia's stock fell 7.1% after initially rising due to a profit report.
• Nvidia's performance was impacted by competition from a Chinese company, DeepSeek.
• Salesforce's stock fell 3.8% despite exceeding profit expectations.
• Snowflake's stock rose 5.7% after reporting stronger-than-expected profits.
• Berkshire Hathaway's stock rose 1.7%, contributing positively to the S&P 500.
• Visa and UnitedHealth Group saw gains of 1.1% and 1.5%, respectively.
• Nvidia accounted for over 22% of the S&P 500's total return last year.
• President Trump announced tariffs on imports from Canada, Mexico, and an additional 10% on Chinese products.
• Treasury yields fluctuated following Trump's tariff announcement.
• The yield on the 10-year Treasury rose to 4.28%.
• A report indicated an increase in unemployment benefit applications, reaching a three-month high.
• Stock markets abroad showed mixed results, with Germany's DAX down 1.1% and Japan's Nikkei 225 up 0.3%.
